title: Child Growth Percentile Tracking
dataSources: Baby feeds (`baby:feed`), baby sleep (`baby:sleep`), diaper changes (`diaper:change`), chore completions (`chore:completion`), allowance ledger (`allowance:ledger`), family calendar (`family:calendar`), growth measurements (`growth:measurement`).
app: Baby-tracking apps (Huckleberry/Baby Daybook exports), chore and allowance boards, shared family calendars, and growth logs — sent to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=growth:measurement
| stats latest(weight_kg) as weight, latest(height_cm) as height, latest(percentile) as pct by child metric
| sort child metric
description: Tracks a child's weight and height against standard growth percentiles so you can see steady progress along their own curve.
value: Healthy growth follows a consistent percentile; plotting it yourself brings reassurance between paediatric visits.
implementation: Record measurements against WHO percentiles into `index=personal`; review each child's growth curve over time.
visualization: Line chart of growth percentile over time per child.
grandmaExplanation: It tracks your child's height and weight against normal ranges, so you can see they are growing steadily.
